gestures.label: hii
gestures.hint: Open palm facing camera with fingers spread wide apart

gestures.label: peace
gestures.hint: Index and middle finger up in a V other fingers closed

gestures.label: thumbs up
gestures.hint: Closed fist with the thumb pointing straight up

gestures.label: no
gestures.hint: Index and middle finger tapping down onto the thumb

gestures.label: flat hand
gestures.hint: Flat palm facing camera all fingers straight and held together

gestures.label: fist
gestures.hint: Tightly clenched fist knuckles toward the camera

gestures.label: point up
gestures.hint: Index finger pointing straight up all other fingers closed

gestures.label: three
gestures.hint: Index middle and ring finger up thumb and pinky closed

gestures.label: pinch
gestures.hint: All five fingertips pinched together into a single point

gestures.label: thumb tuck
gestures.hint: Closed fist with the thumb poking out between index and middle finger

gestures.label: ok
gestures.hint: Thumb and index finger forming a circle other three fingers up

gestures.label: ily
gestures.hint: Thumb index finger and pinky extended middle and ring folded down

gestures.label: call
gestures.hint: Thumb and pinky extended like a phone three middle fingers folded down

gestures.label: thumbs down
gestures.speech: No I do not like this
gestures.hint: Closed fist with the thumb pointing straight down

gestures.label: palm up
gestures.hint: Flat open palm facing upward fingers together as if receiving something

gestures.label: beckon
gestures.hint: All four fingers curled inward toward yourself as if waving someone over

gestures.label: point out
gestures.hint: Index finger pointing straight out sideways other fingers closed

gestures.label: small pinch
gestures.hint: Thumb and index finger almost touching other three fingers closed
